answer: Proposal: each ID/day buys 1 kWh of kiln electricity firing pigment onto hollow shale bricks. Trusted kiln operators sign ID/day/job-bound meter-counter ranges; the registry checks signatures, quota and range nonoverlap. Failure denies listing. Electricity is a recurring expense; kilns are reusable capital; no stake. Dishonest operators can fake use; cheap power weakens deterrence, and orders cap entry. With honest metering, ten IDs require 10 kWh/day despite shared kilns, recovered heat or parallel batches: each unit can be credited only once.
